items.summary: test_torch_tiles.py TorchInferenceCuda test_input_range_grad fails on ROCm 7.14 nightly + torch 2.14 nightly (input_range.grad -0.0005 torch tile vs -0.0187 rpu_base tile, decimal=4 tolerance). Byte-identical failure at validated head 70577b5 and at the moat-sync-60ffe9e tip, so it is toolchain drift, not a port or sync regression; passed June 2026 on ROCm 7.2.1. Needs isolation: torch nightly GPU numerics vs HIP tile path.

decided.note: Not ROCm drift: torch 2.14 changed the clamp gradient at the bound; fixed upstream by IBM/aihwkit#827 (dba3bc3), merged in the sync round at ea1185e; passes on gfx90a, gfx1100, gfx1151
